text: Andaman Sea — KALPA Research Facility, 900 m below.

speaker: arjun
text: Dive log, day nine. Heading for the anomaly near the KALPA facility.

speaker: arjun
text: Depth nine hundred. Pressure nominal. I'm cleared to dock afterwards.

speaker: arjun
text: Nobody will tell me what they actually do down there.

speaker: arjun
text: Big signal. Biological. It's coming from inside the structure.

speaker: arjun
text: The anomaly is a whale. It has to be a whale, near the lab.

speaker: arjun
text: Control, this is Rao, navigation is down, I can't—

speaker: arjun
text: Cabin's flooding. Something's pulling us toward the— what is that?

speaker: arjun
text: It's opening. It's opening like a mouth.
